# pbs_notification_endpoints (Data Source)

Lists all notification endpoint configurations from Proxmox Backup Server. Includes Gotify, SMTP, Sendmail, and Webhook endpoints.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `endpoints` (Attributes List) List of notification endpoints. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--endpoints))

<a id="nestedatt--endpoints"></a>
### Nested Schema for `endpoints`

Read-Only:

- `author` (String) Email author/sender name (SMTP/Sendmail only).
- `body` (String) Webhook request body template (Webhook only).
- `comment` (String) A comment describing this endpoint.
- `disable` (Boolean) Whether this endpoint is disabled.
- `from_address` (String) From email address (SMTP/Sendmail only).
- `headers` (Map of String) Custom HTTP headers for webhook (Webhook only).
- `mailto` (List of String) List of recipient email addresses (SMTP/Sendmail only).
- `mailto_user` (List of String) List of PBS user IDs to notify (SMTP/Sendmail only).
- `method` (String) HTTP method for webhook: POST or PUT (Webhook only).
- `mode` (String) SMTP connection mode: insecure, starttls, or tls (SMTP only).
- `name` (String) The unique name identifier for the notification endpoint.
- `origin` (String) The origin of this endpoint configuration (user-api, user-file, etc.).
- `port` (Number) SMTP server port (SMTP only).
- `server` (String) SMTP server address (SMTP only).
- `type` (String) The type of notification endpoint (gotify, smtp, sendmail, or webhook).
- `url` (String) Target URL (Gotify/Webhook only).
- `username` (String) SMTP authentication username (SMTP only).
